# LinkGuard Platform — Complete AI Agent & System Documentation

> LinkGuard Platform is an enterprise-grade URL shortener, link management platform, and analytics engine built with Spring Boot 3.4, Java 21, Redis 8, PostgreSQL, and React.

## System Overview & Architecture
LinkGuard provides sub-10ms URL redirection using a Redis in-memory Cache-Aside pattern. All incoming visitor IP addresses pass through daily salted SHA-256 cryptographic hashing before storage to guarantee GDPR visitor privacy compliance.

### Core Capabilities
1. **Collision-Safe Base62 Shortening**: Converts long destination URLs into compact 6-8 character short codes or custom branded alias slugs.
2. **Dynamic Vector QR Code Studio**: Generates downloadable SVG and PNG QR codes with customizable color palettes.
3. **Real-Time Click Telemetry**: Tracks visitor click counts, unique visitors, geographic country distribution, operating system, browser family, and HTTP referrers.
4. **Password-Protected Links**: Supports optional BCrypt password protection for sensitive or restricted links.
5. **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Supports USER and ADMIN roles with JWT authentication and audit log telemetry.

## Machine Specifications & Specifications
- [OpenAPI YAML Specification](https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/openapi.yaml): Complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 machine-readable API spec in YAML format.

## Complete REST API Reference

### 1. Create Short URL
- **Endpoint**: `POST https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/urls`
- **Headers**: `Content-Type: application/json`
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "originalUrl": "https://github.com/AniketK100/LinkGuard",
  "customSlug": "linkguard-repo",
  "password": "OptionalPassword123!"
}
```
- **Response (200 OK)**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "URL shortened successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 101,
    "shortCode": "linkguard-repo",
    "shortUrl": "https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/linkguard-repo",
    "originalUrl": "https://github.com/AniketK100/LinkGuard",
    "clickCount": 0,
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T23:50:00Z"
  }
}
```

### 2. Resolve Short Link Redirect
- **Endpoint**: `GET https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/{shortCode}`
- **Response**: `HTTP 302 Found` with `Location: <ORIGINAL_URL>` header.

### 3. User Authentication (Login)
- **Endpoint**: `POST https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/auth/login`
- **Request Body**: `{"email": "admin@linkguard.app", "password": "AdminPassword123!"}`
- **Response**: JWT Access Token object.

### 4. Fetch Click Telemetry Analytics
- **Endpoint**: `GET https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/analytics/{urlId}`
- **Headers**: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN>`
- **Response**: Granular click statistics, country breakdown, and device distributions.

## Error Codes & Resolution Guidance
- `400 BAD_REQUEST`: Invalid URL format or duplicate custom slug.
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED`: Invalid or missing Bearer token.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`: Resource path or short link does not exist.
- `429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 60s window.
